documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: The partner support account once asked about manual status updates. Current permission is withdrawn. Do not send outreach or create a seller follow-up.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is currently in a 'hold' stage due to suppressed or unknown consent, and outreach is explicitly prohibited based on the customer inquiry note. The account has a moderate fit (30) and intent (50) score, but the lack of consent and the blocked status prevent further action.

claims.quote: Do not send outreach or create a seller follow-up.

We will respect this decision and refrain from any follow-up actions. Should there be any changes in the future, we would be happy to assist further. Have a great day!
